notes: 2026-10-14 build (batch 3, legacy lua). Official Dragon Warrior (Bruce Lee class) awakening preheat 'Beast Scroll' (script 2022-10-08; Server_Key tXiaoLongPreheat / tLongPreheating). Entry = the official Beast Scroll window: beast i (Dragon, Kunpeng, Suanni) is open from event day i (derived from the official 'unlocked tomorrow / the day after tomorrow' texts; day 1 = the day this festival started on the server), 7-Day Gift row untouched (nothing claimable), no Peach Village countdown. Not on this server (system message, nothing granted or taken): Beast Trials (Wind Plain / Sea of Sinking Ship / Zhenwu Temple), 7-Day Gift claims (rewards are listed in the client: tDlgAwakenBruceLeeInfo.EntranceItemInfo, but bound/timed items + sign-in rules are server-side), Celestial Pool wishes (Dragon Scales), Peach Village. No Questinfo quests, no official map in FestivalMaps maps.txt.
